92ff178a8276856bc8fe.en: A compass shows four directions: north, east, south and west.
92ff178a8276856bc8fe.id: Kompas menunjukkan empat arah: north (utara), east (timur), south (selatan), dan west (barat).

4f3960a93d1e34f82869.en: On a map, north is usually at the top and south is at the bottom.
4f3960a93d1e34f82869.id: Pada peta, north biasanya ada di atas dan south ada di bawah.

2277b09c0fffbbc29ae2.en: East is on the right and west is on the left.
2277b09c0fffbbc29ae2.id: East ada di kanan dan west ada di kiri.

3fcd611b2cf10b5aef99.en: Clockwise turns go the same way as the hands of a clock.
3fcd611b2cf10b5aef99.id: Putaran clockwise bergerak searah dengan jarum jam.

c395bd8630caaeca99b7.en: A quarter turn clockwise from north faces east.
c395bd8630caaeca99b7.id: Seperempat putaran clockwise dari north menghadap ke east.

16698c80522acd8a8909.en: South is a half turn from north.
16698c80522acd8a8909.id: South adalah setengah putaran dari north.

fe90bd3b3de9dfe4900c.en: West is a quarter turn anticlockwise from north.
fe90bd3b3de9dfe4900c.id: West adalah seperempat putaran berlawanan arah jarum jam dari north.

ce12073abaadb644e8bf.en: Nadia faces north again only after a whole turn.
ce12073abaadb644e8bf.id: Nadia menghadap north lagi hanya setelah satu putaran penuh.

02267c98aacb7ff41a57.en: S is straight above H. Up is north, so S is north of H.
02267c98aacb7ff41a57.id: S tepat di atas H. Atas berarti utara (north), jadi S ada di sebelah utara H.

a550197e1041bab53c6e.en: West is to the left. S is straight above H.
a550197e1041bab53c6e.id: West ada di kiri. S ada tepat di atas H.

5de60b2c6ddc78ef1563.en: East is to the right. S is straight above H.
5de60b2c6ddc78ef1563.id: East ada di kanan. S ada tepat di atas H.

1b4bb84933f73fa53012.en: South is down the grid. S is above H.
1b4bb84933f73fa53012.id: South berarti ke bawah pada petak. S ada di atas H.

4c30ba0f6dd6c828aaf3.en: North and south are opposites, like east and west.
4c30ba0f6dd6c828aaf3.id: Utara (north) dan selatan (south) saling berlawanan, seperti timur (east) dan barat (west).

28e1b3d289a4ab7b0f9a.en: The opposite of east is west. The opposite of north is south.
28e1b3d289a4ab7b0f9a.id: Lawan dari timur (east) adalah barat (west). Lawan dari utara (north) adalah selatan (south).
